class.name: ECSPrefab
class.brief_description: A reusable entity definition: components, field values and child prefabs.
class.description: Prefabs replace packed scenes for the ECS workflow. Create one from the editor (New Resource > ECSPrefab): the inspector lists its components with an [b]Add Component[/b] menu (built-in components and project [ECSComponentSchema]s, plus custom names for components registered from code) and exposes every field of every component as a regular, typed property with undo/redo and revert support. Nest prefabs through [member children] to build hierarchies (turret on a tank, ...). Spawn prefabs with [method ECSWorld.instantiate_prefab], turn live entities into prefabs with [method ECSWorld.create_prefab]. Entities created from a saved prefab carry a replicated [code skip-lint]Prefab[/code] component with the resource path so that clients can re-create local-only components (rendering, physics shapes) for replicated entities. [codeblock] var tank: ECSPrefab = load("res://tank.tres") var entity := world.instantiate_prefab(tank) world.replicate(entity, 1, true) # Also replicates the child entities. [/codeblock]

method.name: add_child
method.description: Appends a child prefab. Children are instantiated as separate entities with a [code skip-lint]Parent[/code] component pointing to the entity created from this prefab.

method.name: add_component
method.description: Adds a component with the given field values (missing fields keep their default). If the component exists, [param values] are merged into it.

method.name: find_sub_prefab
method.description: Returns the nested child at an index path such as [code]"0/2"[/code] (third child of the first child); an empty path returns this prefab.

method.name: get_child_count
method.description: Returns the number of child prefabs.

method.name: get_component
method.description: Returns the stored field values of a component (only fields that were explicitly set).

method.name: get_component_names
method.description: Returns the component names in declaration order.

method.name: get_component_value
method.description: Returns a stored field value, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_component
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the prefab has the component.

method.name: load_from_path
method.description: Loads a prefab from a resource path with an optional child index suffix, e.g. [code]res://tank.tres#0/1[/code] (the format stored in the built-in [code skip-lint]Prefab[/code] component).

method.name: set_component_value
method.description: Sets a field value of an existing component.

members.member: Child prefabs, instantiated as child entities (see [method ECSWorld.instantiate_prefab]).
Component name to field values map. In the inspector each component is shown as a property group with one typed editor per field.
